description.text:
`SQPsych-8b-gemma-Qwen` is a chat model fine-tuned to **roleplay a therapist** in synthetic, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)-informed counseling conversations. It is part of the **SQPsychLLM** family released with the paper *Roleplaying with Structure: Synthetic Therapist-Client Conversation Generation from Questionnaires*.

This checkpoint is **Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct** supervised-fine-tuned on **SQPsychConv (Gemma)**, the synthetic corpus generated by `google/gemma-3-27b-it` from real, de-identified structured client profiles and psychological questionnaires (BDI, HAM-D).

warning.quote: This model must **not** be used to: provide therapy, diagnosis, or any clinical decision to real people;

serving.text_only_input_quote: {"role": "user", "content": "I've felt down and unmotivated for weeks and I don't know why."}
serving.system_prompt: You are an empathetic therapist conducting a CBT-informed session.
serving.notes: The file list has no tokenizer files. tokenizer_config.json and adapter_config.json return 404. The card example calls apply_chat_template and sets max_new_tokens to 512. That max_new_tokens value is not in generation_config.json. The system string is in the card's usage example.

discrepancies: The card YAML lists AIMH/SQPsychConv_gemma, and the card also says the instruction-formatted split used for training is AIMH/SQPsychConv_gemma_finetune. The inventory names only AIMH/SQPsychConv_gemma. Method sft and parent Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct match the card. The paper arXiv:2510.25384 and GitHub src/finetune.py fine-tune meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct and do not print this repository id. The project page lists AIMH/SQPsychLLM-8b-gemma-Qwen, not this repository id, as a fine-tune on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct.
